subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm: page_alloc: remove ALLOC_NON_BLOCK from ALLOC_RESERVES

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch removes the ALLOC_NON_BLOCK flag from the ALLOC_RESERVES set in the Linux kernel's page allocation system. The flag was left in place after a previous change, causing GFP_NOWAIT allocations to consume regular memory below the minimum watermark, leading to hiccups and stalls during bursts of allocations under memory pressure. By removing this flag, GFP_NOWAIT allocations are now stopped short at the minimum watermark, preventing direct reclaimers from failing and preserving the highatomic reserve for its intended use. This change fixes a problem that was observed in synthetic tests but not in production, and ensures that the system behaves correctly even during bursts of memory-intensive activity.
